title: Create Present
description: A platform for creating personalized digital gifts for birthdays, anniversaries, proposals and more, with live previews, private media and shareable experiences.
story: Create Present turns a simple greeting into an interactive surprise. Choose an occasion, personalise the journey, preview the result, then publish and share it through a private link and QR code.
highlights: Private photo and music uploads with QR sharing
demoNote: Explore the public homepage, occasion picker and birthday builder. Google sign-in is required to save drafts and publish gifts.
